spec.title: Error occurrences · Native trial
spec.description: Development telemetry. Usability trial; not a production health dashboard.

spec.name: category
spec.label: Issues category
spec.description: Filters the Issues list and chart.

spec.name: test_errors
spec.label: Test errors
spec.description: Known controlled test errors only; does not infer tests from release or environment.

options.content: Choose an occurrence to inspect its original message and surrounding activity. The chart shows this group over time; clear Release to compare versions. Resolved/assigned state is not tracked.

label_format window_to=`{{ add (unixEpochMillis (__timestamp__)) 300000 }}` | label_format activity=`{{ if .value }}{{ .value }}{{ else if .message }}{{ .message }}{{ else if .event_data_message }}{{ regexReplaceAll "(?s)\n.*" .activity "" | trim | trunc 240 }}` | keep timestamp, activity, event_data_step, event_data_outcome, type, app_version, stored_ns, window_from, window_to, session_id,
